name: Oki Ardana
source:
Massage Style: Balinese
Likes: Mechanics, massage, automotive
Dislikes: Okan

The "twin" brother of Okan Ardana. He is considered a silent and cold person by most people, but he has a passion for work and his hobbies. An automotive mechanic by day, he does work for Full Service at night. He dislikes how Okan meddles and teases him constantly.

The quiet one of the twins. He doesn't speak much and is very blunt. Unlike his brother, he is very stoic and standoff-ish. Physically, he is also hairier. No one really knows much about this intimidating man, but maybe it will be possible to learn more about him once he warms up to Tomoki.

In Full Service, his specialty is the Balinese massage style and his cooperative massage with Okan known as "Twin massage". Okan and him are assigned to guard the mysterious VIP Room.
